title: Clo In Madrid: User Summit 2024 Highlights
description:
The Madrid User Summit was electric! ⚡We were thrilled to see both long-term users and many new faces, with a remarkable 60% increase in attendees this year. This growth mirrors our rapid expansion in Spain, highlighted by the presence of so many incredible brands like MANGO, Gobik, SPRINTER, Bershka, PULL&BEAR, and ZARA.

A heartfelt thank you to everyone who joined us. We can't wait to see you all again next year!

Questions? Comment below or ask in our CLO discord server: https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/7814962429977-How-can-I-join-CLO-Discord-

transcript: Hi everyone, welcome once again to our second User Summit in Madrid. The idea of ​​this event is that you can look around, recognize yourself among you, among the brands. It is my first year here and well, I think it took me like a pleasant surprise. It's been a while, but I remember that I was with a partner that I had, we started to think about how we can help the client to visualize the product that we can offer them. What we did at Happy Poon is to create a 3D department directly, but we also believe that it is very important to pass it on to the patronage team because they see the plan and the physical in five minutes. Now we have the entire internal collection already created from the start and Custom is taking it to a certain part, an external company, and what we want to do is take it all. The most interesting thing for me has been the part of artificial intelligence, because it is something very, very expected of us. Thank you.
